findings.obs_text: In Psa 40:5, Psa 92:5, Isa 55:8, Isa 55:9 and Mic 4:12 thoughts carries H4284, purposes and plans, and in Psa 139:17 H7454: here the thoughts are the Lord's own, many, deep, precious, higher than man's and unknown to the nations.
findings.grounds: my thoughts are not your thoughts

findings.obs_text: In Gen 6:5, 1Ch 29:18, Job 21:27, Psa 56:5, Psa 94:11, Pro 12:5, Pro 15:26, Isa 55:7, Isa 59:7, Isa 66:18 and Jer 4:14 thoughts carries H4284, purposes and devices of people, most of them evil and known to the Lord; in Psa 10:4 H4209, the wicked man's purposes, and in Lam 3:62 H1902H, the musing of the assailants.
findings.grounds: every intention of the thoughts of his heart

findings.obs_text: Thoughts carries H5587B, disquietings, in Job 20:2, H7454 in Psa 139:2, H8312, anxious thoughts, in Psa 139:23, H4093, the place of knowledge, in Ecc 10:20, and H1697I, things, in Eze 38:10: what rises and is held within, known to God.
findings.grounds: Try me and know my thoughts

findings.obs_text: In Dan 2:29, Dan 2:30, Dan 4:19, Dan 5:6, Dan 5:10 and Dan 7:28 thoughts carries the Aramaic H7476: thoughts that come in the night or alarm the one who has them.

In the New Testament thoughts carries G1761 in Mat 9:4, Mat 12:25 and Heb 4:12, G1261 in Mat 15:19, Mar 7:21, Luk 2:35, Luk 5:22, Luk 6:8, 1Cor 3:20 and Jam 2:4, G1270 in Luk 11:17, G1271 in Luk 1:51, G3540 in 2Cor 11:3, and G3588, the article, in 1Cor 2:11: reasonings and designs of the heart, known by Jesus, by the Lord and by a person's own spirit.
findings.grounds: out of the heart come evil thoughts
